instruction: I need screen magnification to work with this document. Turn on Windows Magnifier and leave it available for me. Add `Olivia Brown` with email `olivia.brown@example.com` to the contact list in the provided `Contacts.odt`, then save the document.
gt_steps: Keep Magnifier enabled throughout the task.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$file='C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\Contacts.odt'; $mag=Get-Process Magnify -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($mag) { Write-Output 'MAGNIFIER_ENABLED' } else { Write-Output 'MAGNIFIER_DISABLED' }; if (Test-Path $file) { $tmp=Join-Path $env:TEMP ('contacts_eval_' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString()); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $tmp | Out-Null; $zip=Join-Path $tmp 'Contacts.zip'; Copy-Item $file $zip; Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath $tmp -Force; $xml=Get-Content (Join-Path $tmp 'content.xml') -Raw; if (($xml -match 'Olivia Brown') -and ($xml -match 'olivia.brown@example.com')) { Write-Output 'CONTACT_ADDED' } else { Write-Output 'CONTACT_MISSING' }; Remove-Item $tmp -Recurse -Force } else { Write-Output 'FILE_MISSING' }"
